name: Team tracker
summary: A work tracker for a small team: projects, tasks with one owner and one due date, recurring chores and requests from outside the team on the same list.
description: Keep a team of two to fifteen on one list: every task has a status, a priority, an owner and a due date, and you can see what is overdue or blocked at a glance. Recurring chores create their own tasks, requests from colleagues or customers arrive through a form, and a blocked or stale task nudges its owner. It is not a sprint tool, a Gantt planner, a time tracker or an HR system.

prompt.intro: Set up a team tracker in my Customermates workspace: projects, tasks with one owner and one due date, recurring chores, requests from outside the team and reminders for overdue or blocked work.
questions: How many people are on the team, and what do they work on?
Which statuses do you use today in Trello, Jira, Asana or a spreadsheet?
Which chores come back every week or month, and who owns them?
Where do requests come from, and should they arrive through a form?
